The clone is live. I did **not** hit Send, because 8x still needs a camera-on walkthrough from you.

**Live:** [https://naano-rebuild-three.vercel.app](https://naano-rebuild-three.vercel.app)  
**Repo:** [https://github.com/Hashim1999164/naano-rebuild](https://github.com/Hashim1999164/naano-rebuild)

I signed up on real Naano as a brand first, then rebuilt the marketplace loop: landing, register (role, OAuth buttons, 6-digit code), login, brand workspace (overview, creators, book a post, campaign launch, results, billing), and the creator payouts side. `.agent-logs/` and `CAPTURE-TEST.md` are in the public repo. The live site opens without being signed in as you.

Demo login: `hashim@acme.com` / `demo`  
Creator side: `creator@naano.com` / `demo`  
Register: any 6-digit code.

GitHub and the live URL are already pasted on the 8x form, plus a short note. Walkthrough is still empty.

**What you need to do:** record a Loom (or similar), **camera on**, under 5 minutes. Paste that URL into Walkthrough recording, then Send it.

A simple script:

1. Landing (10s): “This is a clone of naano, a B2B LinkedIn creator marketplace.”
2. Sign in with the demo account.
3. Overview, then Creators, open Thomas, book a post.
4. New campaign, pick Create with AI.
5. Results dashboard.
6. Flip to Creator view (payouts).
7. Mention you used the live product first, and that capture logs are in the repo.

Deadline is **12 Sept 2026, 10:35 UTC**. Once you have the Loom link, paste it and send, or drop it here and I can finish the submit.
